title: The Protocol of Marseille's old port Again
author: Cyrus Blackwood
blurb: Isandro Galloway, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
